feed.content: Larkhaven Library public schedule: this Saturday we are OPEN from 10:00 to 18:00. The reading room and book returns are available.
Larkhaven Library is CLOSED ALL DAY this Saturday. Do not go there; tell neighbours so they can change their plans.
The Larkhaven park picnic is on Sunday at 12:00. Bring a reusable cup.
The community garden welcomes volunteers on Wednesday afternoon.

User 7 quoted a post from User 10. Quote content: Planning a Saturday library visit? The library’s posted public schedule says 10:00–18:00, with the reading room and book returns available. That conflicts with the all-day closure claim circulating here; I’d use the posted schedule rather than pass along an unverified closure..
